note: Built from PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy roadmap (difficulty 4/10, about 200 hours, 1 playthrough) and the official trophy descriptions. Keep cheats off the whole run: they disable trophies and saving. There is no mission replay and no New Game+, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter (15 manual save slots).

stages.text: Finish the story, Chapters 1 to 5, and enjoy it. Do the optional missions as they appear, scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app (200 of 277 base models count toward 100%) and study animals with the binoculars (100 of 255) as you go. Progress made during the story already counts toward the 100% checklist. The one thing you must not skip: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude, the only potentially missable trophy. Questlines for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret all start during the story and stay available after it.
stages.title: Play the story

stages.text: After the story, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. The checklist is closer to 60% true completion: 100 optional missions, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, all robberies (8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations), all 42 shooting-range golds, all 14 drone race locations, all 15 Target Decks, 200 vehicles scanned, 100 animals studied and 15 of 18 meditations. Nothing on the checklist is missable, and everything is doable in free-roam. Work the big counts first (stunts, races, shooting ranges), then the money trophies (launder $250,000, spend $100,000, buy the 8 garages).
stages.title: The 100% Completion checklist

stages.text: Finish the 8 stranger mission strands, then sweep up what is left: the four trophies whose triggers are still unconfirmed at launch (check PowerPyx's guide for updates as players confirm them) and anything the checklist did not cover. A Long Road pops when the checklist is done; the platinum, Vice Got a Price!, pops with your last trophy.
stages.title: Strangers and clean-up
